activity_title: Reworked KPI cards to a full-width, compact, equal-height layout

activity_title: Corrected the Forecast/Actual cost model (dropped 67%-zero template price; used carrier_charge + 8-week baseline)
activity_summary: Root cause: order_shipping_billing_detail.shipping_template_price is 67% zero for the reporting week, so summing it as Forecast made every carrier show a false LEAK. Fix: Actual = carrier_charge (reliable, 4.8% null); Expected = prior-8-week (W19-W26) average carrier_charge per carrier x current-week labels (the workbook README 'default per carrier' fallback, since no rate-card table exists); Variance = Actual - Expected; Status by the workbook rule (trigger 5 GBP, leakage 1%, Others->KILL). Result is realistic: Royal Mail -0.9% CHECK, DHL +3.3% LEAK (+97.46 GBP), net -104.70 GBP.
evidence_refs: dashboard/sql/dashboard_queries.sql Q9 (corrected carrier reconciliation); PostgreSQL W27 actual 12,517.31 GBP vs expected 12,622.01 GBP; DHL +97.46 GBP
reusable_pattern: When a source expected/template column is sparsely populated, check its null/zero rate before using it; derive an expected baseline from a trailing-period average of the reliable actual column per entity
validation_rule: Do not use shipping_template_price as forecast when it is mostly zero; Actual = carrier_charge; Expected = prior-8-week avg carrier_charge per carrier x labels; Status: |Var GBP|>=5 AND |Var %|>1% -> LEAK, else |Var GBP|>=5 -> CHECK, Others -> KILL, else OK
gap_or_risk: No rate-card table in PostgreSQL so Expected is a derived baseline not a true rate-card forecast; carrier_charge mixes GBP+EUR with no FX table
next_action: Ingest a real rate card and carrier invoices to replace the derived baseline

activity_title: Rebuilt dashboard/data.js from validated read-only PostgreSQL results (W27 2026)
activity_summary: Regenerated the embedded dashboardData object for reporting week W27 2026 (2026-06-29 to 2026-07-05) from read-only PostgreSQL: overview (4,020 orders, 389 FBA, 147 Wayfair, 3,484 self-labelled, 3,631 labels, 12,517.31 GBP actual cost), an 8-row carrierSummary, a 7-row dailyControl, 10 KPIs, 72 booking buckets and 2 auto-flagged leakage rows. Made data.js byte-identical to the object embedded in the HTML. No mock data.
evidence_refs: dashboard/data.js; dashboard/sql/dashboard_queries.sql (Q1-Q9); consistency: sum(carrier labels)=sum(daily labels)=3,631; actual 12,517.31 GBP
validation_rule: Embedded data.js must be byte-identical to the HTML-embedded object and every total must equal the PostgreSQL result
gap_or_risk: data.js is a manual snapshot; it needs an automated refresh job to stay current
next_action: Add a scheduled refresh script to regenerate data.js from the query pack

activity_title: Validated all 11 Excel worksheets against PostgreSQL and the dashboard
activity_summary: Compared every worksheet (README, Dashboard, Daily Control, Booking Log, Rate Card, Weekly Invoice Check, Leakage Register, Gap Analysis, Lists, SOP, BLOS Thresholds) across Excel -> PostgreSQL -> Dashboard with metric-level totals. Result: 9 PASS, 2 PASS-with-GAP (Rate Card - no rate-card table; Leakage Register - no dispute table), 0 FAIL. Confirmed the framing that Excel holds dummy W19 sample data while PostgreSQL is the live source of truth (W27), so the pass criterion is Dashboard == PostgreSQL exactly.
evidence_refs: documentation/10_ui_and_validation_report.md (Part 2 - per-worksheet tables); order-math holds on all 7 days
reusable_pattern: Validate a dashboard sheet-by-sheet with a three-way table (source-of-truth DB vs reference workbook vs dashboard) and an explicit PASS / PASS-with-GAP / FAIL verdict per sheet
validation_rule: A worksheet PASSES when Dashboard == PostgreSQL exactly and structure/logic == Excel; dummy workbook totals are reference-only
gap_or_risk: 2 sheets are PASS-with-GAP because their source tables (rate card, disputes) do not exist in PostgreSQL
next_action: Re-validate once rate-card and dispute sources are ingested

activity_title: Added read-only reconciliation query Q9 (corrected carrier baseline) to the SQL pack
activity_summary: Added Q9 to dashboard/sql/dashboard_queries.sql: a read-only carrier reconciliation that classifies free-text carrier_name into carrier families, computes a prior-8-week average carrier_charge per family as the expected rate, multiplies by current-week labels for Expected, and derives Variance versus Actual carrier_charge. All queries are SELECT-only (no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL). Re-confirmed headline figures read-only on 2026-07-08.
evidence_refs: dashboard/sql/dashboard_queries.sql (Q9); read-only re-confirm: 4,020 orders / 3,631 labels / 12,517.31 GBP
reusable_pattern: Derive a per-entity baseline rate from a trailing window of the reliable actual column, then apply it to current volume to produce an expected value
validation_rule: The SQL pack must be SELECT-only; no writes to the production database
gap_or_risk: carrier_family is a documented heuristic over free-text carrier_name (no normalisation table exists)
next_action: Replace the heuristic with an official carrier normalisation map
